record.body:
## Description

After closing verification and the phase-end reviewer pass, start the README full suite (fast non-tmux, then serial tmux) in a detached tmux window in the phase worktree; record one tier-2 check-run at the phase head SHA; extend the phase gate to require head-SHA acceptance passes plus that tier-2 pass; on tier-2 fail create fix work-items under the retry budget (cluster by failing file/module) with no inline verifier fix loop; keep per-task verify_command scoped and update skills/README/verify-budget tests accordingly.

## Approach

1. Add `se_workflow/tier2.py` (or equivalent): start detached tmux in the phase worktree running the README suite; poll/reattach; parse exit code, duration, output digest, failing node IDs; refuse dirty-only runs consistently with check dirty policy.
2. Parent records one `project:check-run` with runner metadata, `revision` = phase head, `evidence_kind: integration` (subject convention e.g. `<phase>-tier2`).
3. Extend execute-phase phase-end order: reviewer → tier-2 start/poll/record → gate (acceptances@head + tier-2@head) → Landing merge. Document recovery if the tmux job is orphaned.
4. On tier-2 fail, create fix work-items via the retry-loop path (cluster by failing test file/module); never reopen `done`; after fixes, rerun tier-2 at the new head.
5. Update `skills/execute-phase/SKILL.md`, related skill wording, README Testing notes, and `tests/test_verify_budget.py` so per-task checks stay scoped while the phase-level full run is required.
6. Prove with `tests/test_tiered_verification.py` (and skill-contract tests as needed).
